predlab_p1_classical.stop_rule: no post-hoc grid additions; amendments only before the affected cell's first result and declared in this file; NEGATIVE cells close without retry; holdout untouched until Phase-5 champions

amendments.change: conditioning window capped at the last 4320 bars (180 days) at both fit and filter time; HAR/OLS/baseline models remain fully expanding
amendments.reason: SARIMAX/MLE estimation on expanding ~37k-observation hourly windows is computationally infeasible; cap declared before any 1h Tier-1 result exists

protocol.note_t2: enet/lgb T2 cells fit on sign target via probability clip of regression output to [0.02, 0.98]

comparisons.secondary: vs Phase-1 champion of the same cell (DM-HLN) — the question Tier 2 actually answers

predlab_p2_ml.stop_rule: no post-hoc feature additions or grid growth; amendments only before the affected cell's first result and declared here; NEGATIVE cells close; holdout untouched until Phase-5

universe.rule: monthly top-200 by prior-month median quote_volume, PIT (month m membership uses data through the last day of m-1)

targets.ret_7d: next-7-day return sum (overlapping), rank; NW lag 10

predlab_p2_t7.test: daily Spearman IC; NW-t on IC series (lag 5; lag 10 for ret_7d)
predlab_p2_t7.stop_rule: signals and combo grids fixed; no post-hoc signal additions; NEGATIVE closes the lead; holdout untouched until Phase-5

tabpfn_ts.note: CPU-feasible check at smoke; drop with declaration if runtime prohibitive

deferred_models.chronos_2: release 2025-10 > dev end; no dev-feasible window
deferred_models.timegpt: Class C — corpus unauditable, excluded on principle

protocol.step_note: 1h cells evaluated every 24th origin (compute bound, declared pre-result; ~1550 forecasts/cell, matches daily-cell power)
protocol.comparison: vs cell champion AND registered strong baseline on IDENTICAL matched windows (baselines re-run on the same origin subset)

predlab_p4_fm.stop_rule: roster and windows fixed; a model may be DROPPED for declared runtime infeasibility but never added; NEGATIVE closes; holdout untouched

amendments.change: tabpfn_ts DROPPED — declared infeasibility: local weights require interactive license acceptance + account token (TabPFNLicenseError in non-interactive environment). Revivable if the operator sets TABPFN_TOKEN; no results were produced.

mcs.procedure: Hansen-Lunde-Nason MCS (arch.bootstrap.MCS), alpha=0.10, block bootstrap size 24 (1h) / 5 (24h), on per-origin loss frames from STORED dev forecasts restricted to common origins
mcs.champion_rule: lowest dev mean loss within the MCS surviving set

ETHUSDT|1h|T3_rv.note: ttm_ens = C2 combination (below); TTM alone lacks dev-wide forecasts (Class-B window) so enters only via the ensemble on its valid window — if MCS window must be common, C2 is evaluated as a SEPARATE matched-window comparison, not in the MCS

T7|ret_24h.test: pairwise DM on daily IC differentials (NW lag 5); champion = highest |mean IC| among models not significantly worse than the best (p>=0.10)

combinations.lgb_cal: C1: ProbClip(LGB) probabilities recalibrated by isotonic regression fit on trailing 4320 (1h) stored prediction-outcome pairs, refit every 168 origins; deterministic; NEW dev forecasts generated from stored lgb predictions (no model refit)
combinations.ttm_ens: C2: 0.5*TTM + 0.5*gjr11 variance forecasts on TTM's valid window (2024-11..2025-03), matched-window comparison vs gjr11 alone

holdout_protocol.who: ONLY champions frozen by the MCS/champion rule above
holdout_protocol.criteria_U4: on holdout: DM p<0.05 vs the cell's registered strong baseline (recomputed causally on holdout) AND effect >= 0.5 x dev effect AND same sign; T2 additionally: accuracy edge >= 1.0pp; T7: |IC| >= 0.02 with NW-t >= 2
holdout_protocol.forensics_on_pass: multi-seed (5) permute-y nulls + sub-period table; report regardless
holdout_protocol.spend_rule: one evaluation per cell, results recorded PASS or FAIL, no re-tuning, no second look

predlab_p5.stop_rule: cells/sets/combinations fixed; no additions after this registration; MCS alpha and champion rule fixed

predlab_pp.inputs: STORED P5 forecasts + T7 panels only; models frozen, never refit
predlab_pp.holdout_note: forecast models are frozen artifacts; strategy layer sees this window exactly once (one-shot per candidate)

S1_t7_lowvol_ls.signal: park_5 rank, monthly top-200 PIT universe
S1_t7_lowvol_ls.family: long bottom-signal quintile / short top-signal quintile; equal- or rank-weighted; optional 2-5d smoothing; <=6 dev configs, ONE frozen for holdout
S1_t7_lowvol_ls.costs: taker 5bp per side per rebalance + realized funding carry per leg where data exists (else 0, disclosed)

S2_harq_voltarget.variants: sigma_hat from harq (champion) vs har_levels vs trailing-20d realized (3 configs)
S2_harq_voltarget.claim: HARQ: vol tracking error to target reduced >=15% vs BOTH baselines (bootstrap p<0.05), SR and MaxDD not worse

S3_sign_filter_exploratory.signal: BTC 1h logit sign (holdout edge +2.51pp; Brier verdict FAIL)
S3_sign_filter_exploratory.family: long/flat filter on 1h BTC, <=4 dev configs

dev_gates.s2_gate: tracking-error reduction >=15% vs both baselines, bootstrap p<0.05, SR/MaxDD not worse

predlab_pp.stop_rule: candidates/configs fixed; failing dev gate = dead this cycle; ledger row per config evaluated
